last update 2021.11.28 19:24  v1.09a

First of all, lets welcome the arrival of Mystia Lorelei! Thanks for everyone’s support, the Yosuzume would join the cast of TBC2！
Because one of our TBC2 dev is currently busy with overseas study, in addition to our commitment on Mystia's Izakaya, TBC2 is left unattained for a long time, thus it is hard for us to implement many of our fixes and improvements in these difficult times. But with new stuff in the team, we can finally realize some of our plans, and we will continue to improve ourservices of TBC2. 

[h2]Collaboration with Mystia's Izakaya[/h2]
Mystia is now a playable character in TBC2! Just talk to her in game and you will receive the activation mission, and after 2 hours of playtime, you can receive the activation for her. 
If you encounter any problem in the activation process, you can email
langqiaoemeng@qq.com
And we will solve it for you ASAP
Alternatively, if you don’t want to participate in the collaboration, you can always purchase the DLC available at the store page.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added the ability for every character to enter the story mode and the last two special stages after you clear it with Cirno. 
[*]Added arrows pointing at remaining enemy in the room, now you can find them all with ease. 
[*]Added the ability to teleport to the current room for those situations where you got stuck in a wall.
[*]Fixed the problem where you cannot focus on cut-ins when playing with a controller.  
[/list]

notes.title: Touhou Blooming Chaos 2 is officially completed today!
notes.content:
[h1]To all Touhou Blooming Chaos 2 fans, Our game is completed![/h1]

Today Touhou Blooming Chaos 2  becomes the complete version, elements promised before have been nearly all realized.  Although there are still incomplete details and  bugs,  we will keep collecting feedbacks to emend them. 

Fourteen months have passed since April 17,  2020,  over 34000 players have owned and played Touhou Blooming Chaos 2, and this number will continue to increase in the future. It's a substantial and cheerful number incouraging us making the game better and better.  

[b]Here,  under the support of you,  players, we formally thank all of you. [/b]

Big changes in the complete version:
[list]
[*] Hero's room exchange change to using UI table instead of throwing items on the ground. 
[*] The final skill damage is now bond to the maximum MP, the formula is [Final damage = (skill damage + buff)*maximum MP/10]. Yet skills have cooldown, increase attack speed to decrease cooldown. 
[*] Open Endless Mode,  All Star Mode,  One HP mode.  They are very challenging, especially All Star Mode, it's all most a new game. Let's see which level can you reach!
[/list]

Meanwhile, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/21718/2__DLC/]four DLCs[/url] are released as promised, take a look whether there is character you like! The gist of this game is providing a grazing experiences, using favorite characters  crashing enemies inevitably in each mode. If you felt good, then the game is worthy.

▲[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1526710/2__3/]DLC3[/url] : Yukari, Eirin, Kanako, Yuka, Junko

▲[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1526720/2__4/]DLC4[/url] : Suika, Shikieiki, Tenshi, Kasen, Kokoro

After this, Touhou Blooming Chaos 2 will collaborate with our new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1584090/]Touhou Msia's Izakaya[/url].  Mystia will become a playable character in Touhou Blooming Chaos, and special characters Satsuki Rin、Riku Ushio、Shien Yuu will enter Touhou Touhou Msia's Izakaya as special customers. Hope you like this plan, please wait for our future announcement. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37196948/277caacb10a81f3d2f0a7ab09319dba2086e270d.png[/img]
▲Welcome to Play Touhou Mysitia Izakaya!

As to Sakuya，Yuyuko，Aya who have been expected to become playable character, might be added via public funding in future. It's a long term plan. 

Don't worry, Touhou Blooming Chaos 2 isn't end yet... 

Ps: The translation of English version is not yet satisfying and most of Japanese translation is still incomplete. So please be patient, we'll be as quick as possible!

notes.title: Touhou Blooming Chaos 2 huge update 2020.07.10
notes.content:
What a long wait! …For almost a month, here finally comes an update.

Today's update features a good amount of stuffs, in hope to enhance your experiences.

Meanwhile, we may add supports to English and Japanese in the next update, and we're now positively working on it, please wait for another while.

By the way, make sure to update your saves before applying the update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37196948/7307dfb1bd61a5fd0c4f5eb16e4b5d293f945ec3.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Contents[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Gamepad is now supported. An instruction is included in the main page for the config. (XBox pad currently works the best, the others though require tests, we welcome any feedbacks.)
[*] New playable character - Rin Kaenbyou
  Rin Kaenbyou is designed to be a comical character, with their skill named after Demacia, Deja Vu and more video game memes. She's also rad to control with, being cheer is what it's all about.
[*] New boss - Komachi Onozuka
  A rather fun opponent, especially when you're hit by her skill "Try Death? Trial Ver." .
[*] New Boss - Yuka Kazami,
  who is probably going to be the most difficult boss so far, feel free to experience it yourself.
[*] New unique mode - Unrestrained Mode.
  Unrestrained Mode is the second unique mode following the Boss Rush one, selected in the east of the town and costs 3 silvers. The mode contains 10 chambers and enemy's spawn rate is increased to 500~1000%, good for farming Foe's Coins, really satisfying.
[*] New location - Nameless Hill
[*] New location - Garden of the Sun.
[*] New location - The Magic Forest.
[*] New soundtracks are introduced.
[*] Korindo will sell higher amount of items as you proceed.
[*] Map, music, and the highest chamber now display in the ESC menu.
[/olist]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Adjusted the style of skill explainations in the ESC menu.
[*] Main plot is split into 3 available modes, the later ones are unlocked after completing their previous ones.
  Bosses appeared during or before the Investgation are fixed, which makes it convenient for farming their coins.
[*] Chance for a special room to appear is decreased from 10% to 7%.
  The chance was raised up to 10% for test purpose and is proven to be pretty awesome. We've now rearranged it to 7%, but you can equip Tewi's suit to make it 10% again.
[*] Updated the tutorial and the config menu for gamepad users.
[*] An alternate formula of item sorting is added in the storage page.
[*] Negatives can now be stored in the storage.
[/olist]

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Hina's explosive marks no longer need to be triggered within a certain distance.
[*] Hina can now perform her 1st or 3rd skill while dashing.
[*] The damage of Hina's explosive marks is now stacked exponentially, 1 mark for 1 damage multiplication, 2 for 2, 3 for 4… up to 6 for 32, respectively.
[*] Marks can now be only stacked up to 6 times.
[/olist]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Fixed the stickiness of the Half[*]Ghost Drill.
[*] Fixed where Yuugi, Chen, Yuyuko don't move when far away.
[*] Fixed Rin's dashing effect.
[*] Fixed the description of Sanae's 3rd skill.
[/olist]
